answer: The pourer tips his wax from the jug into the moulds, and the jug must pour thin or the moulds overflow. Spermaceti beeswax fat renderer taper bond governs the tipping: a bond beeswax fat renderers lodge after rendering room inspections. The fable is the first tip, made at the bench; the falcon is the last, made before the jug is empty, and the plume is the bench itself, sticky with drips. A forger would need 47 false tips and 47 false jugs.
